name: arx-scripting-language-support
description: Language support for the Arx Fatalis scripting language (.asl): highlighting, snippets, diagnostics, completions and navigation
author: Lajos Meszaros <m_lajos@hotmail.com>

contributors.name: DeepSeek Harness (AI coding agent) using DeepSeek-V41-Flash

asl.diagnostics.enabled.description: Enable the diagnostics (the squiggles) for .asl documents.

asl.diagnostics.commands.description: Report the command problems: a word that is not a known AL command (case-insensitive, the underscores are ignored, every `timer<name>` is valid), and a `set` without a variable target.

asl.diagnostics.structure.description: Report structural problems: unbalanced braces, a missing `{` after an `on` event, and a malformed `if` condition.

asl.diagnostics.references.description: Report a `goto`/`gosub` with a missing label, and a duplicated `on` event or label (the game only resolves the first occurrence).

asl.diagnostics.strings.description: Report an unterminated string or an unmatched `~` interpolation.

asl.diagnostics.missingTerminator.description: Report an event block that ends without `accept`, `refuse` or `return`. The game logs a warning for these, but the original scripts are full of them.

scripts.build:watch: nodemon --watch src --watch dist/package.json --exec "npm run build" --ext ts
scripts.lint:watch: nodemon --watch src --watch tests --watch scripts --watch xo.config.ts --exec "npm run lint" --ext ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && rm -rf dist && npm run build
scripts.test:watch: nodemon --watch src --watch tests --exec "npm run test" --ext ts
scripts.publish:marketplace: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && vsce publish --no-dependencies
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.src.json && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json
